text: Emerging research suggests a link between attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and central sensitization (CS), a condition characterized by heightened sensitivity to pain and sensory stimuli. This study aimed to measure the severity of CS symptoms in children with ADHD and in their parents; compare results with those of a neurotypical group; and explore associations between CS symptoms and pain intensity as well as potential familial patterns.
source_label: Exploring central sensitization symptoms in children with ADHD and their parents: a case-control study
